documentation.content: A role stopped sending `crawler/heartbeat` for 15 min (or the VM is down). On the Spot VM a preemption causes this too: the group recreates the VM (same name, disks and IPs) and the alert closes once the roles beat again; `gcloud compute instance-groups managed list-instances voyager-crawler-mig --zone=us-east1-b --project=voyager-prod-ohzkl` shows it. Otherwise check `vc-compose.sh ps` over IAP SSH and the watchdog log in `/var/lib/voyager-crawler/deploy/watchdog.log`. Series are per role, across instances (a recreated VM has a new instance id).
